title: crypto2dev_skcipher.c: register cbc(aes), ctr(aes), xts(aes)
description: Register three AES skcipher algorithms into the kernel crypto API using wolfCrypt as the implementation. Each algorithm: .cra_name is the composed name consumers request (e.g. 'cbc(aes)'), .cra_driver_name is 'wolfkm-cbc-aes', .cra_priority is 300. Context struct wolfkm_aes_ctx wraps wolfCrypt Aes struct. Callbacks: .setkey calls wolfkm_fips_gate() then wc_AesSetKey(); .encrypt/.decrypt call wolfkm_fips_gate() then wolfCrypt scatter-capable API; .exit calls wc_AesFree() then memzero_explicit(). Register all three as a batch via crypto_register_skciphers().
design: Before writing any code: read /proc/crypto on a vanilla kernel to confirm exact .cra_name strings. Do NOT use 'aes-cbc-wolfkm' — use 'cbc(aes)'. Do NOT linearize scatterlists into bounce buffers; use wolfCrypt's streaming scatter API. FIPS gate is the FIRST line of every callback. .exit must use memzero_explicit() not memset() (compiler may elide memset). See DESIGN.md §skcipher.
